meta.title: One Day Trip Sibolga
meta.description: A one-day itinerary for Pantai Pandan, Mursala Island, local food, and a Sibolga sunset.

hero.heading: One Day Trip Sibolga
hero.imageAlt: Tour boats crossing the waters of Sibolga

intro.heading: One day, three sides of the coast.
intro.description: Only have one day in Sibolga? This itinerary brings together the beach, island scenery, local food, and a sunset panorama in one practical route—so a short stay still feels complete.
intro.note: The route starts in Sibolga City and ends at Bukit Panomboman.

destinations.heading: From the shoreline to the evening light

items.name: Pantai Pandan
items.label: Coast
items.description: A coastal destination on the Sibolga–Central Tapanuli border, known for its sea views, easygoing atmosphere, and seafood.

items.name: Mursala Island
items.label: Island
items.alt: A waterfall flowing into the sea at Mursala Island
items.description: An island escape with an iconic waterfall that drops straight into the sea, pristine scenery, and the day’s signature marine experience.

items.name: Kedai Sunset Sibolga
items.label: Sunset
items.alt: The evening view from Bukit Panomboman
items.description: A relaxed hilltop stop at Bukit Panomboman overlooking Sibolga City and the surrounding sea.

timeline.heading: Thirteen hours around Sibolga
timeline.description: Each transfer is accounted for, keeping the day flowing without feeling rushed.

items.activity: Leave Sibolga City for Pantai Pandan.
Enjoy Pantai Pandan and sample local food.
Head to the Pandan jetty for the crossing to Mursala Island.
Explore Mursala Island and its celebrated waterfall.
Visit a local shop for Sibolga chilli crackers and souvenirs.
Take in Sibolga’s panorama and sunset from Bukit Panomboman.

planning.heading: Before you go, here's a plan for IDR 320,000
planning.description: A quick budget and every stop to save before setting out.

items.name: Mursala Island package
items.detail: Return boat, entrance, life jacket, and lunch

cost.summary: This comes to about IDR 320,000 per person, excluding transport to Sibolga and personal spending on additional food or souvenirs.

tips.heading: Small notes for an easier day
items: Start early to make the most of the day.
Check the weather before crossing to Mursala Island.
Wear comfortable clothing and suitable footwear.
Carry enough cash for smaller purchases.
